term: negation and box closure of an admissibility domain
definition: The domain assumptions in LanguagePropagation require D P to imply D (fun x => not P x) and D (Box F P), for every P. With explicitly quantified excluded middle, collapse at v gives two-way agreement along v-to-w; applying collapse twice, first to P and then to Box P, transfers collapse to w. World extensionality, identity predicates, reflexivity and transitivity are not required by this conditional theorem.
note: Stipulated mathematical experiment requested in #266, not an attribution to Hume or a metaphysical account. Historical adoption would require a separate pinned source and interpretation.
